notes.title: Valentine's Day update 💖
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's Day, fellow cosmic horror lovers! 

As a sign of our devotion to the one who haunts our dreams, we have just released an update for Dagon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312070/4e1c1fd3bdd841c1ed2e05bff9b417916193e184.jpg

This update contains:

 2 new languages: Ukrainian and Arabic
 reduced build size
 improved translations
 new Turkish font
 fixed problems with some of the Achievements
 fixed problems with the gamepad usage
 dozens of small fixes and improvements in scenes and UI


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361560


The Great Old One is all alone in the sunken R'lyeh... Let's show him that we think about him as much as he thinks about us on this special day!

notes.title: New game update! (and more)
notes.notes:
New game update:

- new languages: Korean and Czech (Arabic is on the way)
- 9 fonts to choose from (but not for all languages), including dyslexia-friendly fonts
- options to change text and background color
- option to unlock all trivia after finishing the game
- Autoplay (text and voiceovers can be played automatically)
- build size reduced by 25%

We'd also like to remind you about the new The Railway Horror DLC:

notes.title: Dagon in numbers (one year after the release)
notes.notes:
Fellow cultists!

It's been a year since our first experimental game - Dagon: by H. P. Lovecraft - emerged from the depths of R'lyeh.

Our lord, The Great Cthulhu worked hard with all his tentacles on dozens of abacuses, to come up with those blasphemous, cyclopean numbers.

On behalf of the Ancient Ones, we wanted to thank you all for your support!

I'a! Dagon!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40401317/6fec79955aa5a0292734dd748f28cd1cd302bb2b.png

notes.title: Game update and Official DLC Trailer!
notes.notes:
Fellow cultists!

Today we've uploaded the first game update in a long time. It contains a few fixes and improvements:
- added FPS limit when V-sync is disabled (to reduce GPU usage)
- added Shadows Quality in Options
- added the option to replay the last spoken line (middle mouse button or Y/triangle on gamepads)
- fixed a bug preventing Achievements from unlocking in some cases
- fixed the order of Trivia in the menu
- fixes in German translations
- you can now collect Trivia pieces without displaying them immediately
- added HTC Cosmos binding (please let us know if you have any problems with it!)

What's more, with the power of the Great Old Ones we traveled through time and space to plug into the mind of the 7 years old Howard Phillips Lovecraft. This is the projection of what we've seen:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pZTW7Gw8Mo

notes.title: Dagon release date set to 24.09 + DLC announcement!
notes.notes:
Fellow worshippers of forbidden lore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312070/b3bb3131a53560014f2e93af2a8c3cd7742c9d7a.png

Dagon has a release date!

The Lurker From Beyond, Lord Cthulhu, has ordered us to release the game on 24.09! Get ready for your fix of cosmic horror!

The Eldritch Box DLC

We often get asked to open donations for Dagon and while we haven't decided to do it, we thought a cheap, paid DLC would be a good way to allow players to support our future projects.

Enter The Eldritch Box DLC for Dagon, which will be available on release (24.09)! You can check it out here.

The DLC contains an ebook of Dagon and Fishead (the story that most probably inspired Dagon), two different audiobooks of Dagon, official wallpapers and more (to be announced soon).

So, if you'd like to support our work, the best way is to spread the word and wishlist the DLC!

Until next time,
Bit Golem
